svg.title: STC-08 · One dataset. Twenty skins.
svg.desc: Small multiples of the Stagehand sample dataset (62, 84, 48, 91, 70, 56) drawn in each of the twenty themes: theme ground, accent bars with the leader N4 in the second accent, a dashed average line, and the codename set in the theme display face.
svg.text: REF STC V1.0 / REEL V5 · FIG STC-08
The same six sample values in every theme's palette and display face. N4 leads at 91; the average is 68.5.
